info.title: iHRIS API
info.description: iHRIS is an open-source health workforce information system (a Digital Public Good). An iHRIS v5 server is an Express application (`ihris-backend`) in front of a HAPI FHIR R4 store: FHIR resources are read and written through `/fhir`, with iHRIS applying the signed-in user's permissions, while the site configuration, Elasticsearch/SQL reporting, mHero messaging, translation and app-management routes sit alongside it. Authentication is a session: POST `/auth/login` and replay the returned cookie. The OpenFn `ihris` adaptor does exactly that, then calls `/fhir/...` (its `fhir` namespace, re-exported from language-fhir-4) or any path at all (its `http` namespace). Kibana is reverse-proxied under `/dashboards/**` and uploaded files are served from `/tmp/**` and `/ihrisapp/**`; those pass-through trees are not enumerated here.
